description: Orchestrates the OFFLINE build of a project-spec on an ALREADY OPEN project: validates → G5 (rejects safety+autonomous) → serially executes subnets/devices/modules/network/tags/blocks → compiles. STOPS at the 1st error (continueOnError to keep going). NEVER downloads (download is GATE G3, always human). dryRun:true returns the plan without applying. Requires an open project (tia_connect/tia_project_create beforehand). The PLC-scoped steps use the PlcSoftware resolved from the serve after the device step (it is recorded in applied as plc.resolve), never the device name; an unidentifiable PlcSoftware stops with kind plc_unresolved. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

continueOnError.description: true → keeps applying the remaining steps after an error instead of stopping at the 1st

dryRun.description: true → returns the plan without applying

name: tia_spec_apply
title: TIA — apply project-spec (offline orchestrator)
